readerCopy.body: A decision becomes harder to keep theoretical once action starts changing the available options. When Mars conjoins the North Node, initiative and forward movement meet at the same point, making a call, application, boundary, departure, or first piece of work consequential because it creates information thinking alone could not produce. Pressure is useful when it goes behind the move that opens a path. Reacting only to frustration can spend the same energy without changing the larger arrangement.
